about_short_description.short_description: Pingo is a prepaid international and domestic calling card service company.

product.name: International Calling Service
product.description: A prepaid service enabling users to make international calls to landline and mobile phones using access numbers or a mobile app.

product.name: Monthly Calling Plans
product.description: Subscription-based international calling plans offering fixed or unlimited minutes to landlines and mobiles in selected countries.

product.name: Voice Credit Prepaid Service
product.description: A prepaid credit system allowing users to buy voice credit to make international calls to over 200 destinations without a subscription.

product.name: Mobile Recharge Service
product.description: A service that enables users to send prepaid credit to mobile phones worldwide quickly and reliably.

product.name: Travel eSIM Data Plans
product.description: Data-only eSIM packages providing mobile internet connectivity in over 190 countries for compatible devices.

product.name: Pingo Mobile App
product.description: A free smartphone app enabling users to make international calls over Wi-Fi, 4G/5G, or offline using access numbers.
